action: Place probe in the longitudinal plane. Locate the spleen.
interpretation: Visualize the tip of the spleen. Confirm orientation is currently in the longitudinal plane.
Ensure gain is set appropriately to see the spleen nice and clearly.

action: Instruct patient: 'So a big breath in when you're ready'.
Adjust focus controls. Instruct patient: 'And breathe'.
interpretation: Confirm the spleen is seen quite well. Adjust parameters until the view is optimized.

action: Confirm acoustic window. Instruct patient: 'A big breath'.
interpretation: Verify satisfaction with the window before starting the sweep.

action: Angle through the ribs. Sweep probe all the way down and come back up. Instruct patient: 'And breathe'.
interpretation: Visualize through the splenic tissue, angling through the ribs to cover the entire organ.

action: Rotate transducer to the transverse plane. Prepare to perform sweeps.
interpretation: Change view to look at the spleen in the transverse plane.

action: Angle probe specifically between the ribs. Instruct patient: 'Big breath in'. Sweep through the spleen. Instruct patient: 'Breathe normally'.
interpretation: Ensure proper angle between ribs. Perform transverse sweep through the tissue.

action: Prepare to acquire a comparison image of the spleen and kidney.
interpretation: Target the interface to compare the echotexture of the spleen and the kidney (correcting self-correction from liver).

action: Instruct patient: 'A big breath in'. Capture image at the spleen-kidney interface. Instruct patient: 'Breathe normally'.
interpretation: Show the echotexture between the spleen and the kidney to prove that it's completely normal.

action: Annotate image using the keyboard: 'Long Spleen / Left Kidney'.
Prepare for longitudinal spleen image. Instruct patient: 'Big breath'. Focus specifically on the spleen.

interpretation: Capture the static image of the spleen.

action: Place calipers to measure the spleen from the superior to the inferior border.
interpretation: Obtain longitudinal measurement of the spleen.

action: Instruct patient: 'Big breath'. Activate color Doppler. Scan the spleen in longitudinal. Instruct patient: 'Breathe normally'.
interpretation: Look at the spleen with color on to prove that there are no varices.

action: Acquire image of the transverse spleen.

interpretation: Ensure focus is set at the posterior level of the spleen.
Annotate the image properly as transverse.
